sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12565 of 2023
Applicant :- Virendra Pratap Singh @ Ankit Singh
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ravindra Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Ravindra Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Akhilesh Kumar Vyas, learned
A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
141 of 2023, under Sections 411, 414, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 34 I.P.C., registered at Police Station
Munshiganj, District Amethi.
3.

The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 30.07.2023 by an Inspector of police against four persons, including the applicant, on the basis of information received from a mukhbir, alleging that the applicant and Rupak Singh were apprehended and two stolen motorcycles were recovered from their possession and they admitted that they had got those motorcycles financed from the bank on the basis of forged documents.
They stated that other two co-accused persons were also involved in commission of the offence.

entities.text: Virendra Pratap Singh @ Ankit Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
He has submitted that the investigation of the case is going on.

It has also been submitted that the co-accused Rupak Singh has already been enlarged on bail by this court by means of an order dated 28.08.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.1073 of 2023.
6.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.1073 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the alleged recovery has not been witnessed by any independent witness and that although the FIR lodged by the Inspector alleges that the accused persons obtained loans from the bank on the basis of forged documents, no complain has been lodged by the Bank in this regard; that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 31.07.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

Ram.
